name: Polycab India Ltd
about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.

flags.text: Debtor days rose from 32 to 48 in three years: customers are taking longer to pay
Capital work-in-progress is 35% of fixed assets: a big build-out is still to be commissioned

business.what: Polycab makes wires and cables, FMEG products (fans, lighting, switches, pipes, solar) and runs EPC projects. Sales go through channel partners and institutional customers, and it also exports.

segments.name: Wires and Cables
segments.comment: Grew 47% YoY; domestic up 50% on volume growth and realisations; EBIT margin 14.2%.

segments.name: FMEG
segments.comment: Revenue up 124% YoY, led by solar; EBIT margin crossed 10% for the first time.

segments.name: EPC
segments.comment: Revenue INR 6,171 million, up 53% YoY; EBIT margin 7.2%.

ledger.promise: Capex of Rs 1,200-1,600 crore a year through FY30 (Rs 6,000-8,000 crore over Project Spring)
ledger.quote: in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30
ledger.actual: FY26 investing outflow Rs 2,850 cr (FY25: 1,239), above the annual range. CWIP rose from 708 (FY25) to 1,139 (FY26) and 1,401 (FY27). The outflow may include non-capex items.

ledger.quote: we've given a long-term guidance of 11% to 13%.
ledger.actual: Consolidated EBITDA margin: Q3 FY26 12.7%, Q4 FY26 13.1%, Q1 FY27 13.8%, Q2 FY27 14.4%; FY26 13.9%. The data has no wires & cables segment margin.

ledger.quote: in the near to mid term, we may expect 12% to 14% EBITDA.
ledger.actual: Consolidated margin was 13.8% in Q1 FY27 (inside the range) and 14.4% in Q2 FY27 (above it). The Q2 FY27 call did not repeat the 12-14% range.

ledger.promise: FMEG EBITDA margin of 8-10% by FY30, improving every year
ledger.quote: remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30
ledger.actual: Due by FY30. The data has no FMEG segment margin. Reaffirmed on the Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 calls.

ledger.promise: FMEG to grow at 1.5-2x industry growth
ledger.quote: remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth
ledger.actual: The materials have no FMEG segment revenue or industry growth figures, and no later call reports one.

ledger.promise: Wires & cables volume growth of 1.5x the market (18%+ if the market grows 12%) on a full-year basis
ledger.quote: If we are expecting 12% market growth, then we should deliver 18% and plus.
ledger.actual: Management admitted volume shortfalls in Q4 FY26 (gas rationing) and Q1 FY27 (stocking below expectation). Full-year FY27 is not yet reported, and the data has no volume figures.

ledger.promise: Working capital cycle to normalise to 50-55 days (range changed to 45-50 days from Q4 FY26)
ledger.quote: We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.
ledger.actual: FY26 cycle was 39 days (FY25: 64), helped by letter-of-credit payables. The target range was changed to 45-50 days in Q4 FY26. Each call since says reversion is still ahead.

ledger.promise: EPC sustainable operating margin in the high single digits
ledger.quote: the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid- to long term.
ledger.actual: The data has no EPC segment margin. The Q4 FY26 call softened the wording to 'mid- to high single digits'; Q1 and Q2 FY27 went back to 'high single digit'.

ledger.promise: EHV capacity on stream by end of calendar 2026
ledger.quote: Capacity is expected to come on stream by end of this calendar year.
ledger.actual: The Q2 FY27 call moved commissioning to FY28, possibly April or May 2027.

ledger.promise: Some revenue contribution from EHV capacity in FY28
ledger.quote: in FY28 revenues, we can see some contribution from EHV capacity because it's a tender -based business
ledger.actual: FY28 has not started. Commissioning has moved into FY28 (Q2 FY27 call), which leaves less time to earn revenue from tenders that year.

ledger.promise: Exports above 10% of revenue by FY30, with a sizable pickup in FY27
ledger.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
ledger.actual: The data has no export revenue figures. The Q2 FY27 call said the export share looks 'slightly lower optically' because domestic demand is strong.

ledger.promise: Price hikes of 2-4% in the first 1-1.5 months of calendar 2026 to pass on BEE-norm costs
ledger.quote: I believe the price hikes would be in the range of 2% to 4% and which will be taken during the course of first 1 -1.5 months of this calendar year itself.
ledger.actual: No later call confirms the size or timing of the hikes. Consolidated margin went from 12.7% (Q3 FY26) to 13.1% (Q4 FY26).

current_guidance.quote: As these benefits gradually normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to trend towards our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

current_guidance.target: 11-13%, happy to operate at the higher end
current_guidance.quote: we remain confident of sustaining medium - to long -term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.
we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single -digit range

current_guidance.metric: Project Spring growth and margin targets
current_guidance.quote: we would like to be in that guidance range, I think, till FY30, and that's how we continue to maintain our stance of our guidance.
we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.
the market is also going to grow in the next 2 to 3 years to around maybe INR 40,000 to INR 50,000 crores.

current_guidance.target: Margins above current levels if the mix (exports etc.) shifts; no figure
current_guidance.quote: So if all things come together, definitely we'll see margins going to north of what we are seeing today.

current_guidance.target: No adverse or material impact expected
current_guidance.quote: We do not expect any adverse or material impact on our financial or business operations arising from the said situation.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: The promises the reported numbers can check have held up: consolidated EBITDA margin is back to 13.8-14.4% after the Q3 FY26 dip, which fits the guided ranges, and FY26 investing outflow of Rs 2,850 crore exceeded the capex guidance. Against that, the EHV commissioning date slipped from end-2026 to FY28, the working-capital target range was changed between calls, volume came in short in two straight quarters (Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27) despite the 1.5x-market claim, and most segment targets (FMEG, EPC, exports, volumes) cannot be checked with this data.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The lower working capital cycle is temporary and comes from letter-of-credit payables. It will revert to 45-50 days.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: The FY26 cycle fell to 39 days from 64 even though debtor days rose (42 to 48) and inventory days rose (86 to 99). Implied payable days went from about 64 to about 108. FY26 operating cash of Rs 3,811 crore beat PAT of Rs 2,708 crore, largely from the payables effect, and that effect is expected to reverse.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Wires & cables volume fell short in Q4 FY26 (gas rationing, West Asia) and Q1 FY27 (weak stocking, high base).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated revenue still grew 26.9% in Q4 FY26 (8,864 vs 6,986), 39.0% in Q1 FY27 (8,210 vs 5,906) and 52.8% in Q2 FY27 (9,899 vs 6,477). So revenue growth looks driven by price and commodities more than volume. The data has no volume figures to confirm the 1.5x-market claim.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The Q3 FY26 margin dip came from slow pass-through of copper costs and mix, and would recover as prices were passed on.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: EBITDA margin fell from 15.8% (Q2 FY26) to 12.7% (Q3 FY26), then rose to 13.1%, 13.8% and 14.4% over the next three quarters. H1 FY27 margin was 14.1%, still below H1 FY26's 15.2%.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The capex programme is on track and capacity will not run short over the next 4-5 years.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Spending is running ahead of guidance: FY26 investing outflow was Rs 2,850 crore and CWIP climbed to Rs 1,401 crore. But the main new project, the EHV plant, slipped from end-2026 to FY28, so spending is turning into commissioned capacity more slowly than said.

bull.point: Margins are back above the near-to-mid-term range given in Q4 FY26
bull.evidence: Consolidated EBITDA margin rose from 12.7% in Q3 FY26 to 14.4% in Q2 FY27, against the 12-14% near-to-mid-term and 11-13% long-term guidance.
H1 FY27 revenue was Rs 18,109 crore (+46.2% YoY) and PAT Rs 1,787 crore (+38.2%). Q2 FY27 PAT of Rs 990 crore was 42.9% above Q2 FY26's Rs 693 crore.

bull.point: Capex is paid for from internal cash with almost no debt
bull.evidence: FY26 operating cash of Rs 3,811 crore covered the Rs 2,850 crore investing outflow. Borrowings are only Rs 236-272 crore. Management says it is on track for Rs 6,000-8,000 crore of capex over 5 years.
bull.source: Q4 FY26 call p6; reported numbers

bear.point: The EHV project has been delayed
bear.evidence: Commissioning was guided for end of calendar 2026, then moved to FY28 (April/May possible). That puts the FY28 EHV revenue promise at risk.
bear.source: Q4 FY26 call p15; Q2 FY27 call p18

bear.point: Cash flow has been boosted by payables, and that should reverse
bear.evidence: The FY26 cycle of 39 days came from letter-of-credit payables while debtor and inventory days both rose. Management expects a move back to 45-50 days, which would take back working capital.
bear.source: Q2 FY27 call p6; reported numbers

bear.point: Volume promises keep missing, and management will not guide H2
bear.evidence: Volume fell short in Q4 FY26 and Q1 FY27 even with the 1.5x-market guidance. Management declined to guide H2 revenue because of copper uncertainty. It also raised an unspecified legal/regulatory situation that it says will not be material.
bear.source: Q1 FY27 call p12; Q2 FY27 call p15, p5
